organization: Shenzhen Qianhai Shekou Free Trade Zone Hospital (formerly Shekou People's Hospital)

Endocrinology is listed among its specialties and it has an International Specialists Center with billing to commercial insurers; most outpatient departments have staff who can communicate in English. No source describes its diabetes clinics, so call to confirm. Appointments up to 7 days ahead.

organization: Shenzhen Traditional Chinese Medicine Anorectal Hospital
services.note: One of Shenzhen's seven HIV PEP clinics, with the longest hours (until 22:30 every day). The December 2025 report says it also offers oral and long-acting injectable PrEP. PEP must start within 72 hours.

organization: Shenzhen Third People's Hospital (Second Affiliated Hospital of Southern University of Science and Technology)
location.address.en: Building B, 1st floor, 29 Bulan Road, Longgang District, Shenzhen
location.locationNote: A 2021 health-commission notice put the clinic in Building D, 1st floor; the December 2025 report says Building B, 1st floor.
services.note: Shenzhen's designated infectious-disease hospital. Its Love Clinic (爱心门诊) is one of the city's seven HIV PEP clinics; a 2021 notice said that outside clinic hours (and at lunchtime) PEP patients should go to the hospital's emergency department, and bookings can be made through the hospital's WeChat account. Doctors listed for the Love Clinic in a booking directory include HIV antiretroviral treatment specialists. PEP must start within 72 hours. National free ART generally does not cover foreign nationals, so expect to pay.

organization: University of Chinese Academy of Sciences Shenzhen Hospital
location.address.en: 4253 Songbai Road, Matian Subdistrict, Guangming District, Shenzhen
services.note: One of Shenzhen's seven HIV PEP clinics (爱心门诊). PEP must start within 72 hours.

location.address.zh-Hans: 深圳市光明区马田街道松白路4253号

name.en: Shenzhen New Frontier United Family Hospital
location.address.en: 4012 Fuqiang Road, Xinzhou Community, Shatou Street, Futian District, Shenzhen
contact.phone: +86 400 891 9191 (24-hour service centre); +86 755 2351 3555 (24-hour emergency); +852 5801 1515 (24-hour Hong Kong line)
services.note: International private hospital with a 24/7 emergency department and settlement with 50+ insurers. ADHD: its Mental Health Center has English- and Chinese-speaking psychiatrists; one lists ADHD in adults, children and adolescents, treated with psychotherapy and medication. Diabetes: a chief physician of endocrinology is on staff and there are internal medicine and paediatrics departments; call to confirm diabetes clinics. Fees are high without insurance.
name.zh-Hans: 深圳新风和睦家医院
location.address.zh-Hans: 福田区福强路4012号

name.en: Dermatovenerologická klinika – PrEP ordinace, Nemocnice Na Bulovce
location.locationNote: Pavilion no. 9.
hours: PrEP clinic Tue 08:00–12:00 (other times by arrangement).
services.note: PrEP clinic in Bulovka's dermatovenereology department, with counselling and care for people at higher HIV risk. Always book by email first. PrEP isn't covered by insurance.

name.en: HIV centrum – Klinika infekčních nemocí, Nemocnice Na Bulovce
location.locationNote: Building no. 7, 2nd floor, entrance from the outdoor balcony marked 'Speciální ambulance'.
services.note: The national HIV/AIDS centre at Bulovka's infectious diseases clinic. PEP is given here, ideally within 48 hours of exposure; it is not covered by Czech health insurance except for victims of crime (e.g. rape) and healthcare workers injured at work, so others pay. PrEP is prescribed but not covered by insurance; collect it at the hospital pharmacy by the main entrance (call ahead to check stock). HIV treatment isn't described on the page we could open; the hospital's own site blocks automated access, so call to confirm.

name.en: Canadian Medical
location.locationNote: Prague clinics: AFI (Evropská 859/115a, Praha 6), Apeiron (Sokolovská 192, Praha 8), Pankrác House (Lomnického 1705/5, Praha 4), The Park (V parku 2308/8, Praha 11), Waltrovka (Walterovo náměstí 329, Praha 5) and Palác YMCA (Na Příkopě 1041/12, Praha 1). The site doesn't say which clinics offer psychiatry or diabetology.
services.note: Private clinic network used by expats. Psychiatry treats attention and hyperactivity disorders in children (ADHD) but says it is not a specialised facility for adult ADHD. Diabetology offers individual treatment, complication screening for all patients and gestational diabetes care with its gynaecologists; advanced diabetic foot problems go to partner facilities. Direct billing with about 19 international insurers at AFI, Waltrovka, The Park and Apeiron; uninsured people pay the price list. For emergencies call 155.

name.en: CheckPoint and PrEP Point – Dům světla (Czech AIDS Help Society)
hours: Testing sessions in the afternoon/evening on set days (e.g. 19 Nov 15:00–18:00, 23 Nov 16:00–19:00 in 2026; Testfinder listed Mon 16–19, Wed 9–12, Thu 15–18). PrEP Point Mon, Wed, Fri 09:00–17:00, Tue and Thu 09:00–20:00, by appointment.
services.note: Free, anonymous HIV testing with no appointment during opening hours, open to foreigners; results online, by SMS or in person. Syphilis and hepatitis B/C tests are also offered but are temporarily charged from 14 October to 31 December 2026 because ministry funding ran out. The PrEP Point (book on Bookle) prescribes PrEP only to people insured with VZP (111), ZP MV ČR (211), RBP (213), ZPŠ (209), VOZP (201) or ČPZP (205); PrEP itself isn't covered by insurance. ČSAP also helps foreigners keep HIV treatment going (English, WhatsApp +420 720 956 544).

name.en: Venerologie – Dům světla (Czech AIDS Help Society)
services.note: Sexual health clinic: preventive check-ups with testing for gonorrhoea, chlamydia, syphilis, HIV, hepatitis B and C, HPV and other STIs as recommended; treatment of acute symptoms or a possible exposure; PrEP first and follow-up visits; hepatitis A/B, HPV and meningococcal B vaccines. Book on Bookle, where you can choose your preferred language. Insured visits (VZP, ZP MV ČR, RBP, ZPŠ, VOZP, ČPZP) are billed to the insurer and aren't anonymous; prices for self-payers aren't published.

name.en: Centrum diabetologie – IKEM
organization: IKEM – Institut klinické a experimentální medicíny
services.note: The Czech Republic's largest diabetology centre, focused on patients with organ complications: education clinic (including material on travelling with diabetes), podiatry and a diabetic foot programme, endocrinology, nutrition and obesity clinics, and the country's only pancreas and islet transplant programme. Acute admissions +420 236 053 002/3003.

name.en: Medicentrum – Venerologie Praha
services.note: Venereology clinic listed by ČSAP as a PrEP centre. PrEP isn't covered by insurance. The clinic doesn't accept clients of RBP (213) or ZPŠ (209). Contact by phone or email to book.

name.en: Klinika infekčních nemocí a cestovní medicíny 2. LF UK a FN Motol – PrEP
services.note: Specialised PrEP clinic at Motol's infectious diseases and travel medicine clinic; book online. PrEP isn't covered by health insurance; collect it from the FN Motol hospital pharmacy (call ahead to check stock).

name.en: Kontaktní centrum SANANIM
hours: Mon, Wed 13:00–20:00; Tue, Thu, Fri 09:00–20:00; weekends and public holidays 13:00–20:00 (Testfinder, 2021).
services.note: Harm-reduction contact centre for people who use drugs: free rapid finger-prick HIV and hepatitis tests, walk-in, no referral; counselling, needle and syringe programme and opioid substitution treatment.

name.en: Unicare Medical Center
location.locationNote: Reception entrance from Za Lány.
services.note: Private English-speaking clinic (staff speak 16 languages). Psychiatry lists ADHD among issues it addresses, using medication and psychotherapy, but doesn't say whether it diagnoses ADHD or for which ages; ask when booking. Diabetology and endocrinology covers type 1 and type 2 diabetes, education and self-management, and follow-up. Direct billing with insurers such as Aetna, Allianz, BUPA, Cigna and GeoBlue (get a payment guarantee first); uninsured visitors pay at reception.

name.en: HIV centrum – Klinika infekčních nemocí, Ústřední vojenská nemocnice
organization: Ústřední vojenská nemocnice – Vojenská fakultní nemocnice Praha
location.locationNote: Building E, entrance E5.
hours: Phone Mon–Fri 13:00–15:00; visits by appointment only.
services.note: HIV centre at the Central Military Hospital. HIV treatment for patients of insurers 111, 201, 207, 209, 211 and 213. PEP ideally within 48 hours; PrEP for as long as the risk lasts. Neither PEP nor PrEP is covered by insurance (PEP exceptions: crime victims and healthcare workers injured at work). Book by phone; the email isn't for urgent problems or bookings. PrEP can be collected at the ÚVN hospital pharmacy.

name.en: Diabetologické centrum – III. interní klinika, Všeobecná fakultní nemocnice
organization: Všeobecná fakultní nemocnice v Praze / 1. LF UK
location.locationNote: Fakultní poliklinika, building A, 1st floor (diabetic foot clinic: building C1, 1st floor).
hours: Diabetology clinic Mon–Fri 08:00–12:00. Diabetic foot clinic Tue 10:00–15:00, Wed 08:00–13:00, Fri 08:00–14:00.
services.note: Joint VFN and Charles University diabetes centre: full care for type 1 and type 2 diabetes, including people on insulin pumps, and a diabetic foot clinic. Book by phone or email (rezervace.cedo@vfn.cz). Prescriptions by email (recepty.cedo@vfn.cz) are only for regular patients; urgent prescription needs by phone or in person.

name.en: Dětská diabetologická ambulance – Klinika pediatrie a dědičných poruch metabolismu, VFN
organization: Všeobecná fakultní nemocnice v Praze / 1. LF UK
location.locationNote: Dětský areál Karlov (DAK), building E1b, ground floor.
hours: Diabetology Tue 08:00–12:00. Booking by phone Tue–Thu 08:00–10:00 or by email.
services.note: Paediatric diabetology session within the children's endocrinology and obesity clinic. For a first visit send the child's details, insurer, a parent's phone number and a copy of the GP referral. The clinic's catchment area is Praha 1, 2 and 4. The 24-hour records desk is +420 224 967 777.

name.en: Sexuologický ústav – Všeobecná fakultní nemocnice (HIV/STI testing)
organization: Všeobecná fakultní nemocnice v Praze / 1. LF UK
services.note: Testfinder (last updated November 2021) lists HIV, hepatitis and syphilis testing, free with Czech public health insurance. Call before going: the listing is old and the institute's own testing page couldn't be checked.

name.en: Service de diabétologie et endocrinologie — Hôpital Bichat-Claude-Bernard
services.note: Type 1 and type 2 diabetes, diabetic foot, insulin pump and closed-loop setup and follow-up, glucose Holter monitoring, and a day hospital for diabetes assessment and education. Book online (mon.aphp.fr) or call 01 40 25 82 42.

name.en: Service de maladies infectieuses et tropicales — Hôpital Bichat-Claude-Bernard
services.note: HIV infection and STIs are among the department's main areas; it has an urgent infectious diseases consultation and runs the hospital's CeGIDD. Book via Doctolib or phone. Sida Info Service says this department sees people without an appointment, including visitors who have run out of HIV treatment or PrEP; you pay for medicines at the pharmacy.

name.en: CeGIDD — Hôpital Bichat-Claude-Bernard
services.note: Dedicated PrEP consultation line: 01 40 25 72 79. PEP is listed for AP-HP CeGIDDs as a whole rather than this site. Free (or no upfront payment) HIV and STI screening, named or anonymous, open regardless of age or health coverage. Across AP-HP CeGIDDs, PrEP consultations are by appointment and PEP is given during opening hours (start within 48 hours) but not at weekends; at weekends go to an emergency department. Check current hours with Sida Info Service (0800 840 800).

name.en: CeGIDD Croix-Rouge Paris
services.note: Listed by Ville de Paris as a CeGIDD (free HIV, hepatitis and STI screening, open regardless of age or health coverage). Hours and PrEP/PEP availability not published in the sources; call first.

name.en: CeGIDD — Hôpital Fernand-Widal
services.note: Phone line is an answering machine. Free (or no upfront payment) HIV and STI screening, named or anonymous, open regardless of age or health coverage. Across AP-HP CeGIDDs, PrEP consultations are by appointment and PEP is given during opening hours (start within 48 hours) but not at weekends; at weekends go to an emergency department. Check current hours with Sida Info Service (0800 840 800).

name.en: CeGIDD — Hôpital Pitié-Salpêtrière
services.note: Free (or no upfront payment) HIV and STI screening, named or anonymous, open regardless of age or health coverage. Across AP-HP CeGIDDs, PrEP consultations are by appointment and PEP is given during opening hours (start within 48 hours) but not at weekends; at weekends go to an emergency department. Check current hours with Sida Info Service (0800 840 800).

name.en: CeGIDD — Hôpital Saint-Louis
services.note: Free (or no upfront payment) HIV and STI screening, named or anonymous, open regardless of age or health coverage. Across AP-HP CeGIDDs, PrEP consultations are by appointment and PEP is given during opening hours (start within 48 hours) but not at weekends; at weekends go to an emergency department. Check current hours with Sida Info Service (0800 840 800).

name.en: Checkpoint Paris
hours: About 70 hours a week, Mon–Sat, including evenings and Saturdays, with or without appointment (per 2024 activity report).
services.note: Community sexual health centre and CeGIDD for LGBT+ people and sex workers, including migrants without social security. Rapid HIV and hepatitis C tests, full STI check-ups with on-site chlamydia/gonorrhoea PCR (results in about 90 minutes), PrEP start and follow-up, PEP, vaccinations (hepatitis A/B, HPV, mpox), trans health and chemsex support. Free at the CeGIDD for people without health coverage or who want anonymity; professional interpreters used for some patients.

name.en: Centre médico-social Belleville (CeGIDD)
location.nearestTransit: Télégraphe or Place des Fêtes (Métro 11); bus 60
hours: HIV/STI testing by appointment Mon–Fri 09:00–12:15 and 13:30–16:45 (to 18:45 Mon), Sat 09:15–12:15. Rapid HIV test (TROD) by appointment Mon 09:00–12:00 and 13:30–16:00, Wed and Thu 09:00–12:00. Results without appointment after 7 days. (Page dated August 2022; confirm.)
services.note: City-run CeGIDD: free, confidential HIV and STI testing. Booking via Doctolib. Ville de Paris says CeGIDDs are open regardless of age or health coverage. PrEP can be prescribed at CeGIDDs, but the city doesn't say which sites offer it.

name.en: Centre médico-social Ridder (CeGIDD)
hours: HIV/STI testing by appointment Mon, Wed, Fri 12:00–17:30; Tue, Thu 09:00–17:30; Sat 09:15–11:15. Results without appointment Mon–Fri 12:00–18:30, Sat 09:15–11:45. (Page dated August 2022; confirm.)
services.note: City-run CeGIDD: free, confidential HIV and STI testing, with online booking. Ville de Paris says CeGIDDs are open regardless of age or health coverage. PrEP can be prescribed at CeGIDDs, but the city doesn't say which sites offer it.

name.en: Centre de santé sexuelle Frédéric Edelmann (Hôtel-Dieu)
location.locationNote: Hôtel-Dieu hospital, Galerie A1, 6th floor.
services.note: HIV, hepatitis and STI screening (including rapid tests) and STI treatment, free; PrEP start and follow-up; PEP prescription and follow-up (call first, or go to an emergency department and follow up here). Free self-tests and condoms. Access regardless of age or health coverage. Simultaneous interpretation for people who don't speak French. Santé.fr says visits are strictly by appointment (Doctolib or AP-HP portal), while AP-HP says with or without appointment; call to check. Urgent STI/PEP cases can be seen within 24–48 hours.

name.en: Consultation TDAH enfants et adolescents — GHU Paris (Sainte-Anne)
services.note: Specialist ADHD (TDAH, with or without hyperactivity) consultation for children and adolescents at the Sainte-Anne site. Medication and referral rules aren't described in the source; call to ask.

name.en: Consultation TDA/H – Haut Potentiel — GHU Paris (Sainte-Anne)
location.address.en: Site Sainte-Anne, Bâtiment F, 1er étage, 1 rue Cabanis, 75014 Paris
services.note: ADHD and high-potential (giftedness) consultation for children, adolescents and adults. The same building (sector 75G04) also lists an adult neurodevelopmental disorders consultation (TDA/H – HP) without its own phone number. Medication and referral rules aren't described; call to ask.

name.en: Institut Alfred Fournier — Centre de santé sexuelle and CeGIDD
services.note: Listed by Ville de Paris as a sexual health centre (01 40 78 26 00) and CeGIDD (01 40 78 26 71) offering HIV and STI screening; visits with or without appointment. Ville de Paris says CeGIDDs are free and open regardless of age or health coverage. Hours not published; call first.

name.en: Département de diabétologie et endocrinologie (CUDC) — Hôpital Lariboisière
location.locationNote: Outpatient Centre Universitaire de Diabétologie et de ses Complications (CUDC), Pavillon Servet.
services.note: Unstable type 1 diabetes including insulin pumps with closed-loop systems; FreeStyle glucose sensors and telemonitoring; therapeutic education; same-site consultations for kidney, eye, liver and heart complications. Book online (mon.aphp.fr) or call 01 49 95 89 77.

name.en: Le 190 — Centre de santé sexuelle
services.note: Free information, screening and diagnosis centre for LGBT+ people and partners of people living with HIV. Offers consultations without appointment, urgent slots for PEP, new HIV infections and symptomatic STIs, and PrEP follow-up; the Île-de-France Region voted funding in 2026 to extend walk-in hours. Hours not published in the sources; call first.

name.en: Consultation Addictologie-TDAH — Hôpital Louis-Mourier
location.locationNote: In Colombes, just north-west of Paris.
services.note: Adult psychiatry service offering specialised diagnostic consultations for adult ADHD (coordinated by Pr Yann Le Strat). Referral, waiting times and prescribing aren't described in the source; call to ask.

name.en: Service d'endocrinologie, gynécologie et diabétologie pédiatriques — Hôpital Necker-Enfants malades
services.note: Children and adolescents: type 1, slow-onset type 1 and monogenic diabetes, with therapeutic education and dietary, psychological and social support. First appointments online (mon.aphp.fr) or by phone.

name.en: Service de diabétologie — Hôpital Pitié-Salpêtrière
services.note: Reference centre: type 1, type 2, gestational, monogenic and other diabetes; diabetic foot and Charcot foot care; CGM, insulin pumps and closed-loop systems; therapeutic education in short-stay and day hospital units; islet transplantation. Book online via mon.aphp.fr; teleconsultation possible.

name.en: Service de maladies infectieuses et tropicales — Hôpital Pitié-Salpêtrière
location.locationNote: 'Pitié' entrance at 83 bd de l'Hôpital is open 24/7.
services.note: HIV infection, AIDS and STIs are listed areas of expertise; consultations see more than 10,000 patients a year. First appointment requests online, follow-ups via Doctolib. Sida Info Service says this department sees people without an appointment, including visitors who have run out of HIV treatment or PrEP; you pay for medicines at the pharmacy.

name.en: Service de psychiatrie de l'enfant et de l'adolescent — Hôpital Robert-Debré
services.note: Babies and children up to age 15. The department includes a 'Centre d'excellence Trouble de l'attention et l'Hyperactivité' (ADHD centre of excellence). Request a first appointment online (AP-HP portal) or by phone. The page doesn't describe medication or referral rules; French public child psychiatry usually has waiting lists.

name.en: Service d'endocrinologie et diabétologie pédiatrique — Hôpital Robert-Debré
services.note: Children and adolescents with type 1 (including slow-onset), monogenic and type 2 diabetes, hypoglycaemia and obesity. First visits need a health professional's referral and are booked via mon.aphp.fr.

name.en: Hôpital Saint-Antoine — Maladies infectieuses et tropicales and CeGIDD
location.locationNote: Consultations: Bâtiment Mayer, porte B.
services.note: CeGIDD: free HIV, hepatitis and STI screening, named or anonymous, without appointment. PrEP consultations at the CeGIDD. PEP after sexual or blood exposure: call the department or go to the hospital's emergency department. HIV and hepatitis B/C follow-up. Book via Doctolib, phone or email.

name.en: Service de maladies infectieuses et tropicales — Hôpital Saint-Louis
location.locationNote: Enter via Porte 3, secteur vert.
location.nearestTransit: Goncourt (Métro 11) or Colonel Fabien (Métro 2); bus 46 or 75
hours: Walk-in infectious diseases consultation Mon–Fri from 08:30 (except public holidays; limited places, seen in order of arrival). Follow-up and PrEP by appointment (phone Mon–Fri 09:00–16:00, Doctolib or email).
services.note: HIV care from diagnosis to treatment and follow-up; dedicated PrEP consultation. Sida Info Service says the infectious diseases departments at Saint-Louis, Pitié-Salpêtrière and Bichat see people without an appointment, including visitors who have run out of HIV treatment or PrEP; you pay for medicines at the pharmacy.

name.en: 10 Hammersmith Broadway
organization: Chelsea and Westminster Hospital NHS Foundation Trust
hours: Mon–Tue 09:00–19:00; Wed 13:00–19:00; Thu 09:00–16:00; Fri 08:30–12:00. Closed weekends and bank holidays.
services.note: Rapid HIV tests, PrEP access and monitoring (book online), PEP after sexual exposure, STI testing and treatment, and follow-up care for people living with HIV. Same-day appointments are offered but limited; book by phone or online. For routine screening without symptoms the clinic points to Sexual Health London home testing kits. Under NHS rules, diagnosing and treating STIs and HIV is free for everyone, including overseas visitors.

name.en: 56 Dean Street
organization: Chelsea and Westminster Hospital NHS Foundation Trust
services.note: Free NHS sexual health and HIV clinic: STI testing and treatment, HIV testing, PEP, PrEP support and full outpatient HIV care. Book by phone or online; walk-in is mentioned only for people aged 19 or under. Under NHS rules, diagnosing and treating STIs and HIV is free for everyone, including overseas visitors.

name.en: The ADHD Centre (London)
location.locationNote: Second London clinic in Belgravia: 9 Eccleston Street, London SW1W 9LX. Online appointments by Zoom.
services.note: Private, consultant psychiatrist-led assessments for adults and children, with stimulant and non-stimulant medication prescribed and regular reviews. Assessments from £695; in-person adult assessment £1,095, child £1,695. The site advertises assessments within 24 hours to the same week and a written report within 2 weeks.

name.en: Ambrose King Sexual Health Centre (Royal London Hospital)
location.address.en: The Royal London Hospital, Mount Terrace, Whitechapel, London E1 2BB
services.note: Free, confidential sexual health services including screening with HIV testing, and contraception. Opening hours and walk-in rules aren't listed; call before going. Under NHS rules, diagnosing and treating STIs and HIV is free for everyone, including overseas visitors.

name.en: Burrell Street Sexual Health Clinic
organization: Guy's and St Thomas' NHS Foundation Trust
services.note: Walk-in, first come first served, for people with symptoms; priority for under-18s, emergency contraception and PEP. PrEP is by booked appointment only (phone 020 7188 6666, option 4). For a check-up without symptoms, order a home test kit online or collect one at reception. Arrive early; if the clinic is full you may be asked to come back the next day. Services are listed for the trust's sexual health service as a whole. Under NHS rules, diagnosing and treating STIs and HIV is free for everyone, including overseas visitors.

name.en: Camberwell Sexual Health Centre
organization: King's College Hospital NHS Foundation Trust
location.address.en: Ground floor, Camberwell Building, 100 Denmark Hill, London SE5 9RS
hours: Mon, Tue, Fri 08:00–15:30; Wed 12:00–18:30; Thu 10:00–17:30. Closed weekends and bank holidays.
services.note: Walk-in, first come first served, but you may not be seen the same day; booking online through Sexual Health London first is recommended. Priority for under-18s, PEP, emergency contraception and severe symptoms. CliniQ, for trans and non-binary people, is by appointment only. Under NHS rules, diagnosing and treating STIs and HIV is free for everyone, including overseas visitors.

name.en: The Chelsea Psychology Clinic
location.locationNote: Also at 100 Harley Street (W1G 7JA), 45 Pont Street, Knightsbridge (SW1X 0BD), 84 Brook Street, Mayfair (W1K 5EH) and 96 Kensington High Street (W8 4SG).
services.note: Private ADHD assessments for adults (£1,000; combined autism/ADHD £3,500) and, through a separate service, children. A specialist psychiatrist discusses medication options at assessment; the page doesn't say whether the clinic itself prescribes and manages medication.

name.en: Clifden Centre (Homerton Sexual Health Services)
hours: Walk-in Mon, Tue, Thu 09:00–11:30 with booked appointments in the afternoon; Wed 12:00–15:30; Fri 09:00–15:30. Booked Saturday clinic 10:00–15:00 every other Saturday. Men who have sex with men clinic Thu 17:00–19:00; Open Doors clinic for sex workers Thu 13:30–15:30.
services.note: Walk-in and booked appointments (walk-in sessions moved to mornings from 2 November). Routine tests include HIV and syphilis blood tests and chlamydia/gonorrhoea tests. Homerton's HIV care is at the Jonathan Mann Clinic. The trust's pages don't say which clinic offers PEP or PrEP; call 020 7683 4103. Under NHS rules, diagnosing and treating STIs and HIV is free for everyone, including overseas visitors.

name.en: Evelina London Children's Hospital — Diabetes Service
organization: Guy's and St Thomas' NHS Foundation Trust
location.address.en: Evelina London Children's Hospital, Westminster Bridge Road, London SE1 7EH
location.locationNote: Outpatients on Level 0 (Ocean).
hours: Mon–Fri 09:00–17:00. Out of hours, call 020 7188 7188, press 0 and ask for the children's diabetes on-call clinician.
services.note: Children and young people with diabetes: active insulin pump service, education with families and schools, transition to adult care, support in intensive care and for diabetes with kidney disease. The emergency department is always open.

name.en: Guy's and St Thomas' — Diabetes Service
organization: Guy's and St Thomas' NHS Foundation Trust
location.address.en: Diabetes and endocrine day centre, 3rd floor, Lambeth Wing, St Thomas' Hospital, Westminster Bridge Road, London SE1 7EH

name.en: Dr. Baba Saheb Ambedkar Hospital (BSA)
services.note: Government ART centre (DSACS and NACO lists) and a DSACS-listed STI/RTI (DSRC) centre. Government ART centre under NACO. NACO's 2021 guidelines say people living with HIV get free diagnostics and free first-, second- and third-line ART at these centres; they don't say whether non-Indian nationals are covered, so call or visit in OPD hours to ask.

name.en: Fortis C-DOC Hospital for Diabetes and Allied Specialities
location.address.en: B-16, Chirag Enclave, opposite Devika Tower, New Delhi 110048
services.note: Specialist diabetes, metabolic and endocrine hospital with endocrinologists, insulin pump services, an advanced diabetic foot and wound care centre, a diabetic eye lab, dialysis and a 24/7 lab and pharmacy. Children's diabetes care, CGM and education aren't described on the pages checked.

name.en: Guru Teg Bahadur Hospital (GTB)
organization: Government of NCT of Delhi (University College of Medical Sciences)
services.note: Government ART centre (DSACS and NACO lists). UCMS & GTB Hospital ICTC for HIV testing (Room 308, 2015 DSACS list) and a DSACS-listed STD clinic in Dermatology. OPD 09:00–13:00; emergency open 24 hours. Government ART centre under NACO. NACO's 2021 guidelines say people living with HIV get free diagnostics and free first-, second- and third-line ART at these centres; they don't say whether non-Indian nationals are covered, so call or visit in OPD hours to ask.

name.en: The Humsafar Trust SAHYOG Clinic, Delhi
location.address.en: B61 Block 1, Sitapuri Part-1, New Delhi 110045
services.note: Community clinic for gay, bisexual, transgender and hijra communities and people living with HIV. HIV and syphilis testing with pre- and post-test counselling (walk-ins accepted; reports by evening; arrive by 19:30 for testing), doctor check-ups Mon–Fri with some medicines free, psychologist counselling, nutrition counselling and referrals to LGBTQ+-friendly lawyers. Nominal fee Rs 1,000 per year. The page does not mention PrEP or PEP.

name.en: Institute of Human Behaviour and Allied Sciences (IHBAS)
hours: Psychiatry walk-in OPD Mon–Sat, tokens 07:00–12:00; Child Guidance Clinic Tue afternoon, tokens 12:30–14:00.
services.note: Government mental health institute. Child Guidance Clinic and Child & Adolescent Psychiatry Clinic every Tuesday afternoon (tokens 12:30–14:00); adult psychiatry walk-in OPD Mon–Sat mornings (tokens 07:00–12:00). The OPD page does not name ADHD, so ask at registration whether ADHD assessment and prescribing are offered.

name.en: Kalawati Saran Children's Hospital
organization: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare, Government of India (Lady Hardinge Medical College)
services.note: Children's hospital with a government ART centre (DSACS and NACO lists) for children living with HIV. Government ART centre under NACO. NACO's 2021 guidelines say people living with HIV get free diagnostics and free first-, second- and third-line ART at these centres; they don't say whether non-Indian nationals are covered, so call or visit in OPD hours to ask.

name.en: Lal Bahadur Shastri Hospital (LBS), Khichripur
services.note: NACO lists an ART centre (FIART) here; a 2015 DSACS list gives an ICTC for HIV testing in Room 93/3, first floor, Residential Block. Government ART centre under NACO. NACO's 2021 guidelines say people living with HIV get free diagnostics and free first-, second- and third-line ART at these centres; they don't say whether non-Indian nationals are covered, so call or visit in OPD hours to ask.

name.en: Lok Nayak Hospital (LNJP)
organization: Government of NCT of Delhi (Maulana Azad Medical College)
location.address.en: Jawahar Lal Nehru Marg, New Delhi 110002
hours: OPD registration Mon–Sat 07:30–11:30. Diabetes Clinic Mon; Endocrinology Clinic Wed; Paediatric Endocrine Clinic Mon.
services.note: Government ART centre (DSACS and NACO lists); Dermatology is a DSACS-listed STD clinic, and a PPTCT (HIV testing in pregnancy) centre is listed in Gynaecology. Special clinics: Diabetes Clinic Mon and Endocrinology Clinic Wed (OPD Block 3rd floor, rooms 316, 322–325); Paediatric Endocrine Clinic Mon (OPD Block 5th floor, rooms 506–514). New registration Mon–Sat 07:30–11:30 at the Main OPD Building ground floor. Government ART centre under NACO. NACO's 2021 guidelines say people living with HIV get free diagnostics and free first-, second- and third-line ART at these centres; they don't say whether non-Indian nationals are covered, so call or visit in OPD hours to ask.

name.en: Dr. Ram Manohar Lohia Hospital (Atal Bihari Vajpayee Institute of Medical Sciences)
organization: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare, Government of India
location.address.en: Baba Kharak Singh Marg, New Delhi 110001
services.note: Government ART centre (DSACS and NACO lists). ICTC for HIV testing in the Department of Microbiology and a DSACS-listed STD clinic in Dermatology (2015 lists; phone numbers there may be out of date). The hospital site now carries the name Atal Bihari Vajpayee Institute of Medical Sciences and lists medical and paediatric emergency areas. Government ART centre under NACO. NACO's 2021 guidelines say people living with HIV get free diagnostics and free first-, second- and third-line ART at these centres; they don't say whether non-Indian nationals are covered, so call or visit in OPD hours to ask.

name.en: Safdarjung Hospital and Vardhman Mahavir Medical College
organization: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare, Government of India
location.address.en: NH 48, near AIIMS, Ansari Nagar West, New Delhi 110029
hours: ART Clinic Mon–Fri 09:00–16:00, Sat 09:00–13:00. Endocrinology new cases Tue & Thu; paediatric & adolescent endocrine clinic Wed.
services.note: ART Clinic (NACO project) under the Department of Medicine, Mon–Fri 09:00–16:00 and Sat 09:00–13:00. ICTC for HIV testing in Microbiology, Room 554, New OPD Building (2015 DSACS list); Dermatology is a DSACS-listed STD clinic. Endocrinology (5th floor, Super Speciality Block, rooms 512–519): new cases Tue and Thu, follow-up diabetic clinic twice a week, paediatric and adolescent clinic on Wednesdays including young-onset diabetes (onset under 25). Dieticians and health educators teach insulin technique and home glucose monitoring; foot-care advice and a foot lab. Government ART centre under NACO. NACO's 2021 guidelines say people living with HIV get free diagnostics and free first-, second- and third-line ART at these centres; they don't say whether non-Indian nationals are covered, so call or visit in OPD hours to ask.

name.en: Sir Ganga Ram Hospital
location.address.en: Sir Ganga Ram Hospital Marg, Rajinder Nagar, New Delhi 110060
hours: Endocrinology general OPD Tue & Fri 09:00–10:00; private OPD daily 09:00–18:00.
services.note: Paediatrics runs a Child Development Clinic that lists ADHD among the conditions it assesses (with behaviour modification, speech and occupational therapy), plus a paediatric clinic for growth, puberty, obesity and diabetes offering diagnosis, education and ongoing care, with insulin pump and CGM expertise for children. Endocrinology & Metabolism runs a Diabetes and Obesity Clinic (general OPD Tue & Fri 09:00–10:00; private OPD daily 09:00–18:00; endocrine services round the clock). Pump, CGM and education are stated for the children's service.

name.en: Diabetologia – Ospedale Pediatrico Bambino Gesù
services.note: Paediatric diabetology centre (head Prof. Stefano Cianfarani) for children and teens with type 1 and other diabetes; publishes a family guide that includes advice on travelling and time zones with pumps. Education is presented as central to care. A child with signs of diabetes such as ketone breath or marked tiredness should be taken to an emergency department (pronto soccorso) straight away.

name.en: Neuropsichiatria dell'Infanzia e dell'Adolescenza – Ospedale Pediatrico Bambino Gesù
services.note: The hospital's child and adolescent neuropsychiatry unit publishes its ADHD guidance: clinical diagnosis using developmental history and input from parents and school, with medication for moderate to severe ADHD in school-age children. Book through the CUP (06 6818 1). The ADHD page dates from 2019, so check current pathways.

name.en: Endocrinologia e Diabetologia – Policlinico Universitario Campus Bio-Medico
services.note: Endocrinology and diabetology unit: prevention and treatment of diabetes and its chronic complications, and individual and group education courses for type 1 and type 2 diabetes. The university reports the unit uses flash glucose monitoring (FreeStyle Libre 2) and a connected insulin pen. Ask whether a visit is SSN-covered or private when booking.

name.en: Checkpoint Plus Roma
location.locationNote: Via Isernia 4 is Plus Roma's registered address, listed by Testfinder as the testing site; Plus Roma shows the way in a video on its site.
hours: Phone line Tue and Thu 18:00–21:00 (Plus Roma). Testfinder (2021) lists testing Mon and Thu 18:00–21:00.
services.note: Community-run checkpoint: free, anonymous rapid HIV and syphilis tests (Testfinder also lists HCV), with counselling and referral to care. By appointment only; you don't need to give your real name. The site's description mentions PrEP access but the page doesn't explain it; ask when you call.

name.en: Neuropsichiatria Infantile – Policlinico Gemelli
organization: Fondazione Policlinico Universitario A. Gemelli IRCCS
services.note: Paediatric neuropsychiatry unit; behaviour disorders and ADHD are among the conditions treated. Appointments through the National Health Service (SSN booking 06 8880 5560) or privately (06 8881 8881). Medication and waiting times aren't described.

name.en: UOSD Diabetologia – Policlinico Gemelli
organization: Fondazione Policlinico Universitario A. Gemelli IRCCS
hours: ReCUP 06 99 39 Mon–Fri 07:30–19:30, Sat 07:30–13:00. Prescription renewals for regular patients Wed 15:00–17:00.
services.note: Type 1 (injections, insulin pumps, integrated pump-sensor systems), type 2, gestational and pre-existing diabetes in pregnancy (diabeteingravidanza@policlinicogemelli.it), LADA, MODY and other forms; staff certified to insert implantable glucose sensors; multidisciplinary diabetic foot centre with fast-track admission. First visit via ReCUP (SSN) or privately (06 8881 8881). Part of the hospital's Endocrinology and Diabetology area.

name.en: UOC Malattie Infettive – Policlinico Gemelli
organization: Fondazione Policlinico Universitario A. Gemelli IRCCS
location.locationNote: Complesso CEMI, Ala S (outpatients and day hospital ground and first floors).
hours: Outpatient booking line Mon and Thu 13:00–14:00; ReCUP 06 99 39 Mon–Fri 07:30–19:30, Sat 07:30–13:00.
services.note: HIV outpatient clinic and AIDS reference centre: monitoring, antiretroviral therapy including long-acting regimens, hepatitis co-infection and prophylaxis; home-care unit for eligible patients. By appointment only: the first visit is booked through the regional ReCUP, follow-ups with the specialist. Testing, PrEP and PEP aren't described on the page.

name.en: Dermatologia Infettiva – Centro MST e Ambulatorio HIV (Istituto San Gallicano)
organization: IFO – Istituti Fisioterapici Ospitalieri (Istituto Dermatologico San Gallicano IRCCS)
location.locationNote: Closest access to the clinics is from Via Fermo Ognibene 23.
hours: Mon–Fri (closed weekends). Testfinder lists testing Mon–Fri 08:30–11:00. HAART pick-up Thu 14:30–16:00.
services.note: STI centre (prevention, diagnosis and treatment) and a third-level HIV/AIDS clinic covering diagnosis to treatment, with antiretroviral pick-up. IFO says outpatient visits are free and booked through CUP (06 9939); Testfinder (updated November 2025) lists free HIV, hepatitis and STI testing, walk-in or by appointment, no referral. Also sees minors with suspected sexually acquired infections. PrEP and PEP aren't mentioned.

name.en: CHIP – Centro di Prevenzione e Cura HIV e IST (INMI Lazzaro Spallanzani)
location.locationNote: Padiglione Centrale, main hall, ground floor (formerly 'Stanza 13'). Out-of-hours PEP: the Institute's Accettazione, Via Giacomo Folchi 6/A, open 24/7.
hours: Reception Mon–Sat 08:30–13:00 (not public holidays); counselling, rapid tests and STI screening Mon–Sat 08:00–13:00 and Wed 14:00–15:30; symptomatic STI walk-ins 08:30–10:30. Accettazione open 24/7 for urgent PEP.
services.note: Lazio's regional HIV/AIDS reference centre. Free HIV test (lab or 15–20 minute rapid test), confidential or anonymous on request, no GP referral needed; book by emailing stanza13@inmi.it with your name, tax code (codice fiscale), phone and reason. PEP is walk-in (start within 72 hours, ideally 48) and free to assess; out of hours use the 24/7 Accettazione. PrEP: free first consultation, same-day start if suitable; follow-up visits and tests carry the SSN co-payment (ticket) unless exempt. Rapid ART start after a new diagnosis and re-linkage for people who stopped ART. STI tests and specialist visits carry the ticket. Doxy-PEP in selected cases. The page says nothing about visitors or non-residents.

name.en: INMP – Poliambulatorio (Trastevere)
organization: INMP – Istituto Nazionale per la promozione della salute delle popolazioni Migranti e per il contrasto delle malattie della Povertà
location.address.en: Via delle Fratte di Trastevere 52, Roma
hours: Reception Mon–Sat 07:30–13:30, Mon–Thu also 14:00–18:00. PrEP clinic Mon and Tue 08:00–10:00. Phone booking Mon–Fri 08:00–12:00.
services.note: National public institute for migrant health. Runs a PrEP clinic (Mon and Tue mornings) and infectious and tropical diseases visits. Issues STP and ENI codes, which give eligible foreigners without Italian health registration access to National Health Service care; a walk-in STP-ENI clinic serves people without a family doctor. Transcultural mediators on staff. Most clinics need a phone booking.

name.en: Roma Checkpoint
location.locationNote: Entrance on the #Rainbowall side.
hours: Evening sessions; check the booking site (Arcigay listed 18:30–20:30 sessions in April 2024).
services.note: Community testing point: rapid, anonymous, free 4th-generation HIV finger-prick test (result in about 20 minutes) and a rapid syphilis test. Book online (Setmore) or through the Gay Help Line 800 713 713 (toll-free in Italy). The site also has information pages on PEP, PrEP and LGBT-friendly doctors but doesn't say they're provided here.

name.en: UPMC Salvator Mundi International Hospital
hours: Urgent Care daily 07:30–19:00, no appointment needed.
services.note: Private international hospital. Endocrinology treats type 1, type 2 and gestational diabetes (visits, glucose curves, nutrition counselling). Walk-in Urgent Care is a paid service for self-paying or insured patients. International Patient Services (smih_IPS@upmc.it) work in English and Italian; the hospital has agreements with major insurers. Also lists psychiatry and infectious diseases.

name.en: Ambulatorio ADHD adulti – UOC Psichiatria, Ospedale Sant'Andrea
services.note: Adult ADHD clinic in the psychiatry department, open since 2016 (about 30 new patients a year in 2020). A 2020 national survey says the surveyed adult centres prescribe atomoxetine and methylphenidate. The hospital's own pages couldn't be opened, so call the hospital to confirm the clinic still runs and how to book (usually via ReCUP with a psychiatry referral).

name.en: Centro di Riferimento Regionale ADHD per adulti – Policlinico Tor Vergata
hours: Opened in 2022–23 with two clinic days a month (to be expanded).
services.note: Lazio's regional reference centre for adult ADHD, in the psychiatry department: diagnosis, treatment pathways and transition from child services. Book through the regional ReCUP (06 99 39) with a referral reading 'Prima visita Psichiatrica, per diagnosi disturbi dell'attenzione'. Limited clinic days, so expect a wait. The 2023 announcement doesn't say whether medication is started here.

name.en: Centro Specialistico ADHD – Neuropsichiatria Infantile, Policlinico Tor Vergata
location.locationNote: UOSD Neuropsichiatria Infantile: Torre 6, Linea T6, 4th floor.
services.note: Regional reference centre for children and teens up to 18. Assessment with interviews and rating scales, parent training, comorbidity work-up, and the therapeutic plan needed to prescribe methylphenidate (Ritalin) or atomoxetine (Strattera), with dose titration. First visits are booked through the regional ReCUP (06 99 39), usually with a referral (impegnativa); expect waiting lists.

name.en: UOC Endocrinologia e Diabetologia – Policlinico Tor Vergata
location.locationNote: Diabetes and pump clinics: Torre 8, Linea T8, 2nd floor. Diabetic foot clinic: Linea 3, Entrata C, 2nd floor.
services.note: Diabetes and complications care, insulin pump therapy with a dedicated pump clinic, therapeutic education, diabetic neuropathy and a complex diabetic foot clinic. First visits through ReCUP (06 99 39); follow-ups booked at the hospital.

name.en: UOC Malattie Infettive – Policlinico Tor Vergata
location.locationNote: Outpatient clinic: Linea 4, ground floor (access before the bar of Torre 6).
hours: HIV testing Mon–Fri 08:00–11:30; results Tue and Thu 14:00–16:00 (in person only). Clinic Tue and Thu 09:00–12:30.
services.note: Free HIV testing with counselling, anonymous and with no referral needed according to a December 2025 report; HIV clinic and day service; STI clinic. First specialist visits are booked through ReCUP (06 99 39). The unit lists a PrEP email (prep@ptvonline.it) but doesn't describe the service. From December 2025 the emergency department also offers HIV/hepatitis screening to adults.

name.en: Malattie Infettive – Policlinico Umberto I
services.note: Testfinder (last updated December 2021) lists free HIV testing (venous blood), ART, PrEP and PEP, hepatitis and STI testing and treatment, by appointment with no referral needed. STI and hepatitis tests are free only if you're exempt. The hospital's own pages couldn't be opened, so call to confirm current services and how to book.

name.en: Aozora Clinic Shimbashi
location.address.en: 3F New Shimbashi Building, 2-16-1 Shimbashi, Minato-ku, Tokyo
services.note: STI clinic with English pages. PEP (start within 72 hours, 28–30 days): ¥33,000 consultation and 14-day check plus ¥214,500 for 28 days of medicine (incl. tax). Daily PrEP: ¥22,000 first consultation and tests plus ¥132,000 per 30 days; on-demand PrEP by consultation; 3-monthly tests extra. The clinic notes PrEP is self-pay. Its Shinjuku branch has closed.

name.en: The Institute of Medical Science Hospital, The University of Tokyo (IMSUT Hospital)
services.note: Department of Infectious Diseases and Applied Immunology has run an HIV clinic since 1986; about 570 people with HIV under care in 2023, 557 on ART, including long-acting cabotegravir + rilpivirine research. Over 200 HIV outpatients a month in FY2024 (Tokyo Metropolitan Government). The Tokyo Metropolitan Government lists it as a cooperating hospital for emergency HIV preventive medication after occupational (e.g. needle-stick) exposure; the list doesn't say whether it gives PEP after sexual exposure, so call first.
notes: Listed by the Tokyo Metropolitan Government as an AIDS care cooperating hospital (HIV treatment). Japanese HIV hospitals generally ask new patients for a referral letter; if you're already on treatment, bring your records and some medicine with you.

name.en: AIDS Clinical Center (ACC), National Center for Global Health and Medicine Hospital
organization: Japan Institute for Health Security (JIHS), formerly NCGM
hours: PEP service: weekdays 08:30–14:00. Appointment centre: weekdays 08:30–17:00.
services.note: Japan's national HIV centre. PEP after sexual exposure (within 72 hours): weekdays 08:30–14:00 at the ACC outpatient clinic; tell reception you want HIV preventive medicine. All self-pay (Japanese insurance doesn't cover PEP): ¥20,000 first consultation plus ¥10,000 per day of medicine (¥280,000 for 28 days) plus tax, ¥10,000 extra outside service hours; credit cards accepted. You get 14 days of ARVs first, then 14 more after blood tests. Outside hours an ER doctor may give one or several days' supply, then you return to ACC. HIV treatment: new patients need a referral letter (patients treated abroad: in Japanese or English) and should bring at least a month's supply of current medicine; HIV drugs are rarely prescribed at the first visit. Interpreter fee ¥7,700/day when needed. Visitors without Japanese insurance contact the International Health Care Center first (+81-3-6228-0749, support@jihs.go.jp; charged ¥30 per point). The hospital's SH clinic for gay and bisexual men wasn't taking new patients in 2026.
notes: On-site interpreters (English, Chinese, Vietnamese, Nepali, Burmese) on weekday daytimes when available; tablet interpreting in 19 languages.

name.en: Comprehensive Diabetes Care Center, National Center for Global Health and Medicine Hospital
organization: Japan Institute for Health Security (JIHS), formerly NCGM
services.note: Type 1, type 2, secondary and hereditary diabetes: insulin pumps, CGM and carb counting, education admissions, injection and self-monitoring training, nutrition advice, and a foot care and shoe clinic. Referral letter (dated within about 3 months) and appointment normally required; without one, ¥11,000 may be charged. New patients weekdays 09:00–11:00; urgent cases may be seen outside these times. Visitors without Japanese insurance should contact the International Health Care Center first (+81-3-6228-0749; ¥30 per point).

name.en: The Jikei University Hospital
organization: The Jikei University School of Medicine
services.note: Over 200 HIV outpatients a month in FY2024 (Tokyo Metropolitan Government); HIV care through the Infectious Diseases department. The Tokyo Metropolitan Government lists it as a cooperating hospital for emergency HIV preventive medication after occupational (e.g. needle-stick) exposure; the list doesn't say whether it gives PEP after sexual exposure, so call first.
notes: Listed by the Tokyo Metropolitan Government as an AIDS care cooperating hospital (HIV treatment). Japanese HIV hospitals generally ask new patients for a referral letter; if you're already on treatment, bring your records and some medicine with you.

name.en: Juntendo University Hospital: Diabetes & Endocrinology
services.note: Diabetes, other lifestyle diseases and hormone disorders, run by certified diabetes and endocrinology specialists. First visits weekdays 08:00–11:00 and Saturdays 08:00–11:00 (not the 2nd Saturday). The hospital's International Health Care Center (03-5802-1985; Japanese, English, Chinese) arranges care for foreign residents and overseas patients; tourists aren't mentioned, so ask.

name.en: KARADA Internal Medicine Clinic Shibuya
services.note: Listed in PLACE TOKYO's PrEP directory for PrEP (original Descovy or a generic), PrEP monitoring and online consultations, PEP, doxy-PEP, HIV care (the clinic says several specialists work there), STI checks and vaccinations; insurance-covered care also listed. Fees and language support aren't listed. The same group has branches in Gotanda and Nakano.

name.en: Keio University Hospital
services.note: Designated core AIDS treatment hospital in Tokyo with an HIV team of physicians, specialist pharmacists, nurses and social workers (100–199 HIV outpatients a month in FY2024). The Tokyo Metropolitan Government lists it as a cooperating hospital for emergency HIV preventive medication after occupational (e.g. needle-stick) exposure; the list doesn't say whether it gives PEP after sexual exposure, so call first.
notes: Listed by the Tokyo Metropolitan Government as an AIDS care cooperating hospital (HIV treatment). Japanese HIV hospitals generally ask new patients for a referral letter; if you're already on treatment, bring your records and some medicine with you.

name.en: Tokyo Metropolitan Cancer and Infectious Diseases Center Komagome Hospital
services.note: Designated AIDS centre hospital and Tokyo's infectious disease medical centre; among the busiest HIV outpatient services in Tokyo (over 200 patients a month in FY2024, per the Tokyo Metropolitan Government). The Tokyo Metropolitan Government lists it as a cooperating hospital for emergency HIV preventive medication after occupational (e.g. needle-stick) exposure; the list doesn't say whether it gives PEP after sexual exposure, so call first. Reservations 03-3823-4890.
notes: Listed by the Tokyo Metropolitan Government as an AIDS care cooperating hospital (HIV treatment). Japanese HIV hospitals generally ask new patients for a referral letter; if you're already on treatment, bring your records and some medicine with you.

name.en: National Center for Child Health and Development (NCCHD): Division of Endocrinology and Metabolism
organization: National Center for Child Health and Development
services.note: Type 1 and type 2 diabetes from fetal life to young adulthood, with specialist nurses, dietitians and pharmacists and health and lifestyle education; accepts patients from overseas. Reservations 03-5494-7300 (weekdays 09:00–17:00). Patients living overseas go through a medical coordinator with a referral letter and pay double the Japanese insurance fee.

name.en: National Center for Child Health and Development (NCCHD): Department of Psychosocial Medicine
organization: National Center for Child Health and Development
services.note: Psychiatric and psychological care for children, adolescents and pregnant women, including comprehensive treatment for neurodevelopmental disorders such as ASD and ADHD with medication, psychotherapy and parent support. Reservations 03-5494-7300 (weekdays 09:00–17:00). Patients living overseas must go through a medical coordinator with a referral letter and are charged double the Japanese insurance fee.

name.en: National Center of Neurology and Psychiatry (NCNP) Hospital: Child Psychiatry
organization: National Center of Neurology and Psychiatry
hours: Main line weekdays 08:30–17:15; closed weekends, holidays and 29 Dec–3 Jan.
services.note: National psychiatric centre; its child psychiatry department treats neurodevelopmental disorders including autism spectrum disorder and ADHD. First visits are requested online or via the consultation desk; revisits via the booking centre (042-346-2190, weekdays 09:00–15:00). Referral rules and medication aren't described on the pages read.

name.en: Tokyo Metropolitan Okubo Hospital
services.note: AIDS care cooperating hospital (50–99 HIV outpatients a month in FY2024, per the Tokyo Metropolitan Government); its ER is the contact on the TMG emergency preventive-medication list (occupational exposure). An International Health Care Center opened in October 2025 for residents and overseas visitors, with English-speaking staff on weekday daytimes and tablet/voice interpreting; call the main line and ask for the International Office.
notes: Listed by the Tokyo Metropolitan Government as an AIDS care cooperating hospital (HIV treatment). Japanese HIV hospitals generally ask new patients for a referral letter; if you're already on treatment, bring your records and some medicine with you.

name.en: Personal Health Clinic (Ueno)
location.address.en: 6F Ueno Fuji Building, 3-39-3 Yushima, Bunkyo-ku, Tokyo 113-0034
hours: Mon, Tue, Thu, Fri 14:30–20:30; Sat 12:00–15:00 and 16:30–20:00. Closed Wed, Sun and public holidays. Last reception 15 min before closing.
services.note: Sexual health clinic with English-speaking doctors, nurses and staff (other languages by phone interpreter). 15-minute HIV test, PrEP and PEP (generics available) and testing/treatment for all STIs. Walk-ins accepted; some services bookable online. Not covered by insurance: you pay in full (cash or card); ¥4,000 to sign overseas insurance forms. PLACE TOKYO's PrEP directory also lists PrEP follow-up and hormone therapy.

name.en: Private Care Clinic Tokyo (Shinjuku)
services.note: Walk-in sexual health clinic with English service. PEP (within 72 hours): ¥77,000 incl. tax for a 30-day set of a generic bictegravir/FTC/TAF tablet, including same-day HIV, hepatitis B and kidney tests and the 1-month test. PrEP: generic, ¥12,100 per month (daily or 30 on-demand pills), ¥5,500 for a 4-pill on-demand set, plus ¥2,750 first consultation; adults 18+. Self-pay only (tests ¥3,850–19,800, treatment ¥3,300–23,100); cash or card. PrEP/PEP reception about 11:00–12:30 and 14:30–19:30. A second branch near Tokyo Station is listed in PLACE TOKYO's PrEP directory.

name.en: Shinjuku City Public Health Center: free anonymous HIV/STI testing (at Higashi-Shinjuku Health Center)
location.address.en: Higashi-Shinjuku Health Center 2F, 7-26-4 Shinjuku, Shinjuku-ku, Tokyo
location.nearestTransit: Higashi-Shinjuku Station (Toei Oedo / Fukutoshin lines), exit A2, about 3 min
hours: Set dates only; regular sessions reception 14:30–16:00, evening sessions 18:00–19:00. Check the schedule online.
services.note: Free and anonymous: HIV test always included; syphilis, chlamydia and hepatitis B on request. Set dates only (afternoon sessions, reception 14:30–16:00, plus some evening sessions); book online or by phone (03-5273-3859, weekdays 08:30–17:00) from a month ahead until the day before. Results in person a week later; no certificates. Shinjuku City publishes the schedule in English, and MHLW's HIV testing map lists this site as offering English, Portuguese, Spanish and Thai. Testing site only (no PrEP, PEP or treatment).

name.en: Shinjuku Higashiguchi Primary Care Clinic
location.address.en: 6F Shinjuku Pandora Building, 3-23-12 Shinjuku, Shinjuku-ku, Tokyo
hours: Weekdays 18:00–22:00; Sat, Sun and holidays 14:00–20:30. Closed only over New Year.
services.note: Evening and weekend clinic listed in PLACE TOKYO's PrEP directory for PrEP (Descovy, original or generic), PEP, STI checks, hormone therapy and vaccinations. Open every day except New Year. Fees and staff languages aren't listed.

name.en: Shirakaba Clinic
hours: Wed–Fri and holidays 13:00–16:30, 18:00–21:00; Sat–Sun 10:00–12:00, 13:30–17:00. Closed Mon–Tue.
services.note: Listed among HIV/AIDS medical institutions in Shinjuku City's HIV/AIDS support map (infectious-disease internal medicine, dermatology, psychiatry, counselling). A 2026 guide lists a same-day HIV, syphilis and hepatitis B test package for ¥3,850 (medical certificate ¥3,300), appointment only, and says the clinic has an English page. PrEP, PEP and HIV treatment weren't confirmed in the sources; call to ask.

name.en: St. Luke's International Hospital: Endocrinology
services.note: Type 1 and type 2 diabetes, mostly as outpatients (insulin can be started in clinic), with Joslin-style education classes; service in Japanese and English. Appointment system: bring a referral letter before calling 03-5550-7120; scheduling can take over a month. The ER is open 24/7 for urgent problems. Uninsured patients pay in full on the day; extra ¥33,000 for same-day/unbooked visits and ¥77,000 out of hours.

name.en: St. Luke's International Hospital: Infectious Diseases
services.note: Listed by the Tokyo Metropolitan Government as an AIDS care cooperating hospital (50–99 HIV outpatients a month in FY2024). The Tokyo Metropolitan Government lists it as a cooperating hospital for emergency HIV preventive medication after occupational (e.g. needle-stick) exposure; the list doesn't say whether it gives PEP after sexual exposure, so call first. The 24-hour ER handles out-of-hours contacts on that list. Uninsured patients pay in full on the day; first-time visitors without an appointment pay an extra ¥33,000 (weekday daytime) or ¥77,000 (out of hours).
notes: Listed by the Tokyo Metropolitan Government as an AIDS care cooperating hospital (HIV treatment). Japanese HIV hospitals generally ask new patients for a referral letter; if you're already on treatment, bring your records and some medicine with you.

name.en: TELL Counseling: Psychological Assessment for Children
location.locationNote: Tokyo office in Omotesando; see the contact page for the address.
services.note: English or Japanese assessments for ADHD, autism, developmental and learning problems for under-18s (adults only case by case, usually not accepted); reports always in English. In person at the Tokyo office, intake and feedback online; report about 6 weeks after the last session. Fees (incl. tax): intake ¥24,200–36,300; comprehensive neuropsychological assessment ¥435,600. Parents/guardians start the process. TELL doesn't say it prescribes; its listed psychiatrist wasn't taking appointments, so medication needs a separate doctor. Waitlists may apply.

name.en: Tokyo Metropolitan Shinjuku East Exit Testing & Counseling Room (Shinjuku Higashiguchi Kensa Sodanshitsu)
location.address.en: SIL Shinjuku Building 2F, 2-46-3 Kabukicho, Shinjuku-ku, Tokyo
location.nearestTransit: Seibu-Shinjuku Station north exit (about 1 min); Shin-Okubo (JR Yamanote, about 5 min); JR Shinjuku east exit (about 10 min)
hours: Mon–Fri 15:00–20:00 (Wednesdays women only); Sat–Sun 13:00–17:00. Closed public holidays (except 1–30 June and 16 Nov–15 Dec) and New Year.
services.note: Free, anonymous HIV test (standard, not rapid) with syphilis tested at the same time; chlamydia and gonorrhoea urine tests only 1–30 June and 16 Nov–15 Dec. Booking required, from 2 weeks ahead: online (Tokyo HIV Testing Booking Site) or the booking centre on 03-6694-3566 (10:00–20:00). Results a week later, in person only; no certificates. Test at least 60 days after a possible exposure for an accurate result. Wednesdays are for women only. The page doesn't mention English support. It doesn't provide PrEP, PEP or treatment (testing site only).

name.en: Tokyo Metropolitan Tama Area Testing & Counseling Office (Tachikawa)
location.address.en: 2F Tokyo Metropolitan Tachikawa Welfare and Health Building, 2-21-19 Shibasaki-cho, Tachikawa-shi, Tokyo
hours: Weekends (per a 2026 guide); call to confirm.
services.note: Tokyo Metropolitan Government testing office for the Tama area; the TMG describes its HIV tests as free and anonymous. A 2026 guide says it offers same-day HIV and syphilis tests on Saturdays and Sundays and that English is available by phone (050-3801-5309, 10:00–20:00). Testing only.

name.en: Tokyo Medical and Surgical Clinic
location.locationNote: Opposite Tokyo Tower.
hours: Mon–Fri 08:30–17:30; Sat 08:30–13:00. Out-of-hours urgent consultations available.
services.note: International clinic for the foreign community with doctors trained in the US, UK, Australia and New Zealand. Primary care doctors manage chronic conditions including diabetes; same-day appointments for acute problems where possible and out-of-hours urgent consultations; dietitian and podiatry also offered. Not part of Japanese National Health Insurance (self-pay). Book online or by phone.

name.en: Tokyo Medical University Hospital
services.note: One of Tokyo's highest-volume HIV hospitals (over 200 outpatients a month in FY2024, per the Tokyo Metropolitan Government); HIV care via Clinical Laboratory Medicine / Infectious Diseases. The Tokyo Metropolitan Government lists it as a cooperating hospital for emergency HIV preventive medication after occupational (e.g. needle-stick) exposure; the list doesn't say whether it gives PEP after sexual exposure, so call first.
notes: Listed by the Tokyo Metropolitan Government as an AIDS care cooperating hospital (HIV treatment). Japanese HIV hospitals generally ask new patients for a referral letter; if you're already on treatment, bring your records and some medicine with you.

name.en: Tokyo Mental Health
location.locationNote: Shintomi Therapy Office; psychiatry clinic held at American Clinic Tokyo (3F No.1 Niikura Bldg., 1-7-4 Akasaka, Minato-ku).
services.note: English-language counselling, psychology and psychiatry. Psychological testing for adults and children covers ADHD, learning difficulties and autism (not accepting enquiries for children under 8). Psychiatry by a UK-licensed English-speaking psychiatrist focused on medication for conditions such as depression and anxiety; whether ADHD medication is prescribed isn't stated. Waiting list possible. TRICARE provider.

name.en: Tokyo Metropolitan Children's Medical Center: Endocrinology and Metabolism
services.note: Paediatric endocrinology department; diabetes is among the common conditions treated. A referral letter isn't required. Book on 042-312-8200. The hospital also provides paediatric emergency and critical care.

name.en: Tokyo Metropolitan Children's Medical Center: Child and Adolescent Psychiatry
services.note: Large child and adolescent psychiatry department (202 beds, 14 full-time doctors); developmental disorders such as autism and ADHD are a core focus, with outpatient day care and team care. Book on 042-312-8200. Referral rules, waiting times and medication aren't described; call to ask. English pages available.

name.en: Tokyo Women's Medical University Hospital: Diabetes & Metabolism
services.note: Type 1, type 2, gestational and other diabetes and complications; dedicated clinics for children and young people with type 1 ('Young' sessions), pregnancy, kidney disease and genetic diabetes. Insulin pumps (CSII, SAP, hybrid closed loop; 167 users in 2023) and CGM (FreeStyle Libre 2 and Dexcom G7 available as self-pay options). Team education by nurses, dietitians and pharmacists. Bring a referral letter (referral reception weekdays 07:30–14:00); web first-visit booking available.

name.en: Tokyo Women's Medical University Hospital: HIV care
hours: HIV clinic: Wed, Fri and Sat.
services.note: HIV care is given in the haematology outpatient clinic on Wednesdays, Fridays and Saturdays only. Over 200 HIV outpatients a month in FY2024 (Tokyo Metropolitan Government). Referral letter needed for referred patients. The Tokyo Metropolitan Government lists it as a cooperating hospital for emergency HIV preventive medication after occupational (e.g. needle-stick) exposure; the list doesn't say whether it gives PEP after sexual exposure, so call first.

name.en: The University of Tokyo Hospital: Department of Child Psychiatry
services.note: Treats ADHD (including with other conditions), autism, tics, learning disabilities and other childhood conditions, with parent training for parents of children with ADHD; inpatient developmental assessment for adults is mentioned under autism. Referral, waiting times and medication aren't described.

name.en: The University of Tokyo Hospital: Diabetes and Metabolic Diseases
services.note: Specialist diabetes outpatients every day; insulin pumps (CSII and sensor-augmented pump), CGM, genetic diagnosis (e.g. MODY), weekly outpatient classes and inpatient education by certified diabetes educators, and a diabetic foot clinic. Children: the hospital's Pediatrics department lists diabetes and endocrine disease. Contact International Patients about visits without Japanese insurance.

name.en: The University of Tokyo Hospital: Infectious Diseases
services.note: Government-designated AIDS centre; HIV specialists provide treatment, and the outpatient clinic does antigen/antibody and viral nucleic-acid tests for infections. The Tokyo Metropolitan Government lists it as a cooperating hospital for emergency HIV preventive medication after occupational (e.g. needle-stick) exposure; the list doesn't say whether it gives PEP after sexual exposure, so call first. Contact the hospital's International Patients service about visits without Japanese insurance.
notes: Listed by the Tokyo Metropolitan Government as an AIDS care cooperating hospital (HIV treatment). Japanese HIV hospitals generally ask new patients for a referral letter; if you're already on treatment, bring your records and some medicine with you.

name.en: The University of Tokyo Hospital: Neuropsychiatry
services.note: University psychiatry department listing developmental disorders such as autism spectrum disorder and ADHD among its specialties; outpatient care by advance appointment. The page doesn't specify ages, referral or medication; Japanese university hospitals usually expect a referral letter.

services.note: Major public hospital with an infectious diseases department. Hospital PrEP and HIV clinics need a referral. hours: Mon & Fri 10:00–15:00; Tue & Thu 12:30–17:30; Wed 14:30–19:30 (per Fast-Track Cities directory; confirm).

name.en: PrEP/STI Clinic — Sete Rios (ULS Santa Maria)
services.note: Public sexual health clinic: HIV, hepatitis and STI testing (free with an SNS number), PrEP, STI treatment and contraception. Walk-in and by appointment. In July 2025 GAT reported waits of a year or more for a first PrEP appointment at Lisbon's three hospital PrEP clinics.

name.en: Al-Noor Specialist Hospital
services.note: 500-bed MOH hospital with a diabetes centre, which served 89 patients during the 2022 Hajj season (16,656 emergency visits in the same period). In 2024 it opened a 24-hour heat-stroke and heat-exhaustion centre run by its emergency department.
notes: No address, phone or website found in the sources checked.

name.en: International Medical Center (IMC) Makkah
services.note: Diabetes and Endocrinology Center for all ages: adult endocrinology and a consultant in paediatric endocrinology and diabetes, with diabetes educators (self-management skills) and clinical dietitians. Pumps, CGM and foot care are not mentioned.
notes: Languages are those listed for the paediatric endocrinologist.

name.en: Saudi German Hospital Makkah
services.note: Endocrinology Department in Makkah; its consultant in endocrinology and metabolism lists diabetes mellitus and its complications among conditions treated. Pumps, CGM and paediatric diabetes care are not mentioned. Book online or by phone/WhatsApp.
notes: The phone number is the group's site-wide line; it is not labelled as the Makkah hospital's. No street address in the sources checked.

name.en: Action for AIDS — Anonymous HIV Testing and Counselling
services.note: Named by the Ministry of Health (2008) as an anonymous HIV testing site. Check AfA's website for the current location and hours.

name.en: DSC@Kelantan Clinic (Department of STI Control)
hours: Mon–Fri 08:00–16:00. Closed weekends and public holidays.
services.note: Singapore's public specialist clinic for sexually transmitted infections, with subsidised care. New patients book first. Listed as a PrEP provider. Around 2022, guides quoted S$100–200 per consultation, with branded PrEP at about S$300–400 per month at pharmacies; generic PrEP can be bought online with a prescription.
notes: 1800 252 1324 is a confidential counselling line.

name.en: Institute of Mental Health — Child Guidance Clinic
services.note: Receives ADHD referrals from REACH for school-age children. Public child ADHD care in Singapore is mainly by referral (polyclinic, CHAS GP or the school-linked REACH teams); consultations and therapy get subsidies of up to 70%.

name.en: KK Women's and Children's Hospital — Child Development Programme and Child & Adolescent Mental Wellness
